onSortChange.description: Callback when the sort option changes. Use to update search results, persist user preferences, or trigger analytics.

SortBy.description: The SortBy container manages sorting for search results, offers customizable criteria, and automatically maintains sort state for both default and custom options.

onSearchResult.description: Callback when a search result is selected or interacted with. Use to track clicks, navigate to product pages, or trigger analytics.

SearchResults.description: The SearchResults container shows products from a search. You can customize it with slots, run separate instances, and it takes care of loading, errors, and real-time updates.

onPageChange.description: Callback when the user changes pages. Use to load new results, update the URL, or trigger analytics.

Pagination.description: The `Pagination` container handles paging for search results. It shows next, previous, and page number controls and keeps the page in sync with the results.

Facets.description: The Facets container lists and manages search filters (facets) to refine product search results.
